parameters.name: APIEnable
parameters.description: Enable or disable FemtoAwareness API exposure on FAP

parameters.name: QueueEnable
parameters.description: Enable or disable Request queueing for the API

parameters.name: Queueing
parameters.description: Determines how FAP handles simultaneous requests from different Applications to Femto Awareness API.

parameters.name: MaxAPIUsersNumber
parameters.description: Determines the Max Number of different Applications that can send Requests to Femto Awareness API.

parameters.name: NotificationsUserIdentifierMSISDN
parameters.description: Specifies whether the Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN) has to be used as UserIdentifier in Femto Awareness Notifications. A value of {{true}} means that the MSISDN is send as user identifier, a value of {{false}} means that an anonymous reference is used.

parameters.name: SubscribeToNotificationsResponseCallbackData
parameters.description: Specifies whether the OPTIONAL Argument "Callback Data" has to be used in Responses to Requests to "Subscribe To Femto Awareness Notifications".

parameters.name: QueryFemtocellResponseTimezone
parameters.description: Specifies whether the OPTIONAL Argument "Timezone" has to be used in Responses to Requests to "Query Femtocell Status".

object.description: This object contains parameters related to the Femto Awareness API.
